papers.title: Weight Scale Rebalancing: Transferable Training Recipes for Transformers
topic: 权重重参数化与尺度转移
papers.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 byline: Department of Mathematics and Mathematical Statistics, Umeå University, Sweden.
papers.code_status: 固定v1全文与摘要未找到作者专用公开源码；未找到/尚未发布，不把通用参考库当本文实现。
papers.local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.udvr import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: CIFAR200/300epochs with grids and three seeds; ImageNet300epochs on8 A100s;120M-1.3B language models over7Btokens with three seeds.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Read-only published configuration, not measured local time. CPU tiny-pair autograd/Adam diagnostic estimated below10seconds across three seeds; no models/data downloads.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅验收CPU小矩阵重平衡、两种正则与形状学习率组件

papers.summary: 把自然配对矩阵拆成方向U/V与非优化buffer D，attention双侧尺度守恒，FFN仅吸收U侧尺度；保留不同正则和形状学习率。仅CPU L1机制，不是跨模型免调参效果复现。

papers.title: Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention
papers.first_author_affiliation: ELLIS Institute Tübingen / MPI-IS / Tübingen AI Center / KTH Royal Institute of Technology
papers.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 author superscripts1,2,3,4; Antonio Orvieto lists1,2,3.
papers.code_status: 固定v1全文与摘要未找到作者专用公开实现；fla、FLAME和lm-evaluation-harness是通用依赖，不等于本文代码。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Four linear mixers and softmax at about340M parameters,20layers,width1024,15Btokens,4096context,batch128,28672steps; additional61.7M/2.52Btoken intervention sweeps.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Published model/token/arm counts; no full pretraining or checkpoint download. CPU weighted-loss and tiny causal-model diagnostic estimated below10seconds across three seeds.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅验收CPU TLCE权重、短窗重置与梯度隔离组件

papers.summary: TLCE用停止梯度的full/short log-prob差，针对超过1nat且已有128token短上下文的位置加权，权重cap5并按总权重归一化。只实现CPU损失与短窗接口，不声称线性注意力召回能力。

papers.title: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
papers.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 byline; collaborators also list Zhongguancun Academy and Manifold AI.
papers.code_status: 原文作者代码链接存在，但2026-11-25 git ls-remote返回Repository not found、raw/main/README.md返回404；未核实可读源码或commit，不等于确认已公开。
papers.deferral_reason: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；18套世界模型、多层flow训练和四域大批候选规划超单卡有界预算，不用固定候选fixture替代核心生成器。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 18 frozen H-JEPA hierarchies; per-level six-block width512 flow heads trained25epochs,batch1024; four control domains,150-450episodes per method,100/100/200candidates and polish sweeps.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Cost inferred from published model/training/evaluation matrix. GPU model and wall time are not provided; none is invented. No model/data download or trial reproduction.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；review-only，无可执行operator、无自动重试或Evolve

papers.summary: 在冻结H-JEPA每层用hindsight轨迹训练flow提案，四步Euler生成候选，rollout critic选择；可先做短有锚优化，再去掉anchor按真实rollout cost重选。仅论文审查，高成本完整实验不复现。
